instruction: How to add grace mode in VCL
output: echo 'sub vcl_hit { if (obj.ttl >= 0s) { return (deliver); } if (obj.ttl + obj.grace > 0s && std.healthy(req.backend_hint)) { return (deliver); } return (fetch); } sub vcl_backend_response { set beresp.grace = 24h; }' > /etc/varnish/grace.vcl
